title: Reflexive differential trace for a degree-p purely inseparable cover
statement: Let $p$ be prime, let $T$ be a scheme of characteristic $p$, and let $q:V\to U$ be a finite morphism of Noetherian normal integral $T$-schemes whose function-field extension is purely inseparable of degree $p$ [def-pc-scheme], [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism], [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], [def-weil-pbc-normal-ring], [def-pc-integral-scheme], [def-sc-function-field], [def-weil-pbc-finite-purely-inseparable-extension]. Suppose that $\Omega_{U/T}$ is coherent [def-sc-relative-differential-sheaf], [pqf-def-coherent]. For every integer $i\geq1$ there is a canonical $\mathcal O_U$-linear map $\operatorname{Tr}_q:q_*\Omega^i_{V/T}\to(\Omega^i_{U/T})^{**}$. Here $\Omega^i=\bigwedge^i\Omega$ is the quotient of the $i$th tensor power by the alternating relations, and $M^{**}=\mathcal Hom(\mathcal Hom(M,\mathcal O_U),\mathcal O_U)$. Its generic restriction is independent of the generator and is characterized as follows. Write $F=k(U)$, $E=k(V)=F(g)$, $g^p=f\in F$, and work over an affine open $\operatorname{Spec}\Lambda\subset T$. For $\eta_j\in\Omega_{F/\Lambda}$ and $0\leq a<p$, it sends $\eta_1\wedge\cdots\wedge\eta_{i-1}\wedge g^a\mathrm dg$ to $0$ for $a<p-1$ and to $\eta_1\wedge\cdots\wedge\eta_{i-1}\wedge\mathrm df$ for $a=p-1$. It annihilates the image of $E\otimes_F\Omega^i_{F/\Lambda}$. These maps restrict to open subsets and agree generically for any two such models of $E/F$.
